priorityList: Maintain Battle Stance at all times.
Use Pummel to interrupt enemy spellcasting.
Maintain Rend on the target, refreshing if it has less than 1.5 seconds remaining (or less than 10 seconds if Colossus Smash is nearly ready).
Cast Ravager when Colossus Smash has 1.5 seconds or less remaining on cooldown.
Cast Avatar and Colossus Smash together as your primary burst window.
Cast Champion's Spear while the Colossus Smash debuff is active on the target.
Use offensive trinkets and racial buffs (like Berserking or Blood Fury) during the Colossus Smash window.
Cast Demolish while Colossus Smash is active and you have stacks of Colossal Might.
When the target is in Execute range (<35% HP with Massacre), cast Mortal Strike only if you have 2 stacks of Executioner's Precision or a Battlelord proc.
When the target is in Execute range, prioritize casting Execute as your main Rage spender.
Outside of Execute range, cast Execute immediately whenever Sudden Death procs.
Cast Wrecking Throw if no other high-priority abilities are available.
Cast Slam as a filler to spend excess Rage when all other abilities are on cooldown.
